articles.title: JPMorgan says Hyperliquid's rise threatens Circle's USDC economics
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid's deal with Circle and Coinbase creates a "prisoner's dilemma" that puts pressure on earnings from the dollar-pegged stablecoin.

articles.title: For pension funds, tokenization’s real play is balance-sheet management, Fidelity’s Lai says
articles.snippet: Fidelity International’s Giselle Lai argues that the most compelling long-term use case for tokenized funds is balance-sheet management for large, global institutions, not 24/7 liquidity.

articles.title: Bitcoin's BIP-110 sparked a fight over who gets to decide the future of Bitcoin
articles.snippet: BIP-110 sought to limit non-financial data on Bitcoin's blockchain but instead reignited debates over censorship and decentralization.

articles.title: Solana community lead enters UK by-election with onchain transparency pitch
articles.snippet: Superteam UK lead Stephen “Cap” Newnham is taking on Nigel Farage in the Clacton by-election with pledges on pension reform and onchain transparency.

articles.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 4: OP_CHECKSIGFROMSTACK and OP_CAT
articles.snippet: OP_CSFS authenticates signatures over arbitrary data. OP_CAT concatenates stack values into a single message. Together, they let Bitcoin scripts verify transaction structure at spend time, without pre-signed key management or new consensus rules beyond the two opcodes themselves.
